components.label: General
components.body: Height and spacing drive every takeoff quantity — 6′ panels on 8′ centers set post count, rail lengths, and picket coverage for any run. Opening costs — material procurement/delivery and small-tools/disposables fee — are priced separately and don't change the fence spec.

components.label: Posts
components.body: Pressure-treated and incised for ground contact; posts finish level with the panel top, so no exposed post or cap in the standard build. Dig holes at least 24″ deep, use an aggregate base, and set with roughly 120 lb of concrete per post. Corner lots: side fence facing the street must sit back 5′ from the lot line.
components.installNote: Dig holes at least 24″ deep; aggregate base; ~120 lb concrete per post.

components.label: Rails
components.body: Two cedar nailers carry the pickets; the 2×4 cap rides the top rail and takes the same stain as the rails — flat profile, no ornamental post caps.

components.label: Pickets
bullets: Fill fasteners — 12–15 ga stainless ring shank (assumed)
components.body: Flat-top cedar boards gapped a quarter inch or less — reads as full privacy from the street while letting the fence breathe. This is the one approved Si View style; no board-on-board, shadowbox, or ornamental 36″ option.

components.label: Trim
bullets: Trim fasteners — 15 ga stainless trim nails (assumed)
components.body: A single 1×4 cedar trim band at the top rail finishes the panel edge — same species, same stain as the rest of the fence. Matches the HOA's published fence detail drawing.

components.label: Finish
components.body: Every visible fence, post, and gate must be stained within 60 days of completion with the Association's pre-approved color — Sherwin-Williams Woodscapes Semi-transparent Exterior Stain, custom formula 3558-789 ("Asteroid"). One color for the whole fence — frame, pickets, and trim match.

components.label: Hardware
bullets: Fill fasteners — 12–15 ga stainless ring shank
Trim fasteners — 15 ga stainless trim nails
Brackets — none (Si View standard build uses nailed/screwed direct framing)
components.body: Stainless steel fasteners and post-setting material specified for the Si View standard build. No brackets are used; framing is nailed or screwed direct.

components.label: Paint / Stain / Seal
bullets: One color for frame, pickets, and trim
components.body: Sherwin-Williams Woodscapes Semi-transparent Exterior Stain, custom formula 3558-789 ("Asteroid"). One color for the whole fence — frame, pickets, and trim match.

components.label: Finish
components.body: Closing costs for this build — ground remediation and material dump/haul fees. Remediation bag quantities are not yet configured (tracked separately).

components.label: Gates
components.body: Not part of the Si View approved standard build — no man gate included in this style.

components.label: Community Specifications
bullets: Finish: Sherwin-Williams Woodscapes semi-transparent stain, formula 3558-789 ("Asteroid"), within 60 days of completion
Setback: corner lots — side fence facing the street set back 5 ft from the lot line
ARC: new fence construction requires Architectural Review Committee approval (via PayHOA) before building
components.body: HOA-specific rules and deadlines that apply to the whole fence project and don't map to a standard fence section.

rulesSummary: Pickets: 1×4 or 1×6 cedar, flat top, ≤¼″ gap between boards
Rails: 2×4 cedar top and bottom nailers with 2×4 cedar cap
Posts: 4×4 pressure-treated, max 8 ft on center
Finish: Sherwin-Williams Woodscapes semi-transparent stain, formula 3558-789 ("Asteroid"), within 60 days of completion
Setback: corner lots — side fence facing the street set back 5 ft from the lot line
ARC: new fence construction requires Architectural Review Committee approval (via PayHOA) before building
footer.arcDisclaimer: Unofficial planning tool — submit your fence plan to the Si View ARC through PayHOA before you build. This blueprint shows the one approved Standard Si View Privacy Fence style only.
